test_case_name: Accept All Cookies on Digital Identity Page

intents.intent: Click the 'Acconsento' button to accept all cookies on the digital identity page.
And then check that the cookie consent banner is dismissed and cookies are accepted.

test_case_name: Access Cookie Options from Digital Identity Page (Mobile)

intents.intent: Click the 'Più opzioni' link to open cookie options on mobile.
And then check that the cookie options or privacy policy page is displayed.

test_case_name: Access Cookie Options from Digital Identity Page (Desktop)

intents.intent: Click the 'Più opzioni' link to open cookie options on desktop.
And then check that the cookie options or privacy policy page is displayed.

test_case_name: Navigate to 'Persone e Famiglie' Section from Digital Identity Page

intents.intent: Click the 'Persone e Famiglie' link in the main menu.
And then check that the 'Persone e Famiglie' section is displayed.

test_case_name: Navigate to 'Business' Section from Digital Identity Page

intents.intent: Click the 'Business' link in the main menu.
And then check that the 'Business' section is displayed.

test_case_name: Navigate to 'Exclusive' Section from Digital Identity Page

intents.intent: Click the 'Exclusive' link in the main menu.
And then check that the 'Exclusive' section is displayed.

test_case_name: Open Main Menu from Digital Identity Page

intents.intent: Click the 'Menu' button to open the main menu.
And then check that the main menu is displayed.

test_case_name: Open Login Panel from Digital Identity Page

intents.intent: Click the 'Accesso clienti' button to open the login panel.
And then check that the login panel is displayed.

test_case_name: Open Call to Action 'Scopri il conto' from Digital Identity Page

intents.intent: Click the 'Scopri il conto' button to view account information.
And then check that the account information or related landing page is displayed.

test_case_name: Open Chat or Contact from Digital Identity Page

intents.intent: Click the 'Parla con noi' button to open the chat or contact section.
And then check that the chat or contact section is displayed.

test_case_name: Open Search Panel from Digital Identity Page

intents.intent: Click the 'Search' button to open the search panel.
And then check that the search input field is displayed.

test_case_name: Perform Desktop Search on Digital Identity Page

intents.intent: Type $name into the 'Cosa posso fare per te oggi?' input field.
Click the search button to submit the search query.
And then check that the search results are displayed based on the entered query.

test_case_name: Reset Desktop Search on Digital Identity Page

intents.intent: Click the reset search button to clear the search input field.
And then check that the search input field is cleared.

test_case_name: Perform Mobile Search on Digital Identity Page

intents.intent: Type $name into the 'Cerca' input field.
Click the search button to submit the mobile search query.
And then check that the search results are displayed based on the entered query.

test_case_name: Login as Guest on Desktop from Digital Identity Page

intents.intent: Type $email into the 'E-mail' input field.
Type $name into the 'Password' input field.
Click the 'ENTRA' button to log in as a guest.
And then check that the user is logged in as a guest and redirected appropriately.

test_case_name: Enable 'Mantieni L'accesso' Option During Guest Login (Desktop)

intents.intent: Type $email into the 'E-mail' input field.
Type $name into the 'Password' input field.
Click the 'Mantieni L'accesso' checkbox to enable the option.
Click the 'ENTRA' button to log in as a guest.
And then check that the user is logged in as a guest with the 'Mantieni L'accesso' option enabled.

test_case_name: Recover Password from Guest Login (Desktop) on Digital Identity Page

intents.intent: Click the 'Recupera Password' link to initiate password recovery.
And then check that the password recovery process or form is displayed.

test_case_name: Register as Guest from Digital Identity Page (Desktop)

intents.intent: Click the 'Registrati' link to start the guest registration process.
And then check that the registration form or process is displayed.
